profile.name: Ahmed Egeh
profile.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building production SaaS systems

experience.summary: I build and run the production SaaS at BidX, working across distributed systems and repositories. Laravel and Vue on the front end, Go and PHP services on the back end, plus internal dashboards so the support team can handle complex operations without friction.
highlights: Took scheduling from V1 to V2: SQS-backed queues, workers, cron/supervisor, and a rollout that actually hits the right execution windows.
Wired Amazon Selling Partner and Advertising into the product: orders, reports, SKUs, and sales landing in ClickHouse, plus ACOS and data-quality fixes.
Shipped internal admin tools for clients, agencies, ASINs, notifications, scheduling, and support.
Kept production boring in a good way: clearer errors, deploy/env scripts, Sentry, PHPStan/Rector cleanup, and fast hotfixes when something slipped.
Tightened Vue and Angular flows: search, pagination, forms, localization, and reporting UI.

experience.summary: Remote full-stack work on Cobrowser’s Symfony and Angular product: subscriptions, payments, cart, and keeping customer data locked down. The company was later acquired by Conversation24.
highlights: Built subscription plans, checkout, and payment links.
Connected external shops through API2Cart so catalogs and orders stayed in sync.
Encrypted sensitive records in PHP/Symfony and surfaced that safely in Angular.
Added product presets for Facebook Catalog and WhatsApp customer flows.
Covered the work with PHPUnit, Jest, and Karma tests.
Jumped on production hotfixes and kept shipping on both sides of the stack.
